C01.title: Entity and ownership
C01.question: Which legal entity owns the product, contracts and securities?
C01.evidence_required: Dated registration, ownership and entity perimeter matched to the assessed business.
C01.counter_test: Check similarly named entities, former names and mismatch between invoices, product and fundraising entity.
C01.decision_use: Establish the entity, ownership, and transaction eligibility.

C02.title: Customer problem and demand
C02.question: Who has demonstrated demand or willingness to pay for the current offer?
C02.evidence_required: Segment-specific demand evidence that distinguishes interest, use, purchase and repeat use.
C02.counter_test: Find inactive users, rejected offers, unpaid pilots and alternatives purchasers already use.
C02.decision_use: Test demand and reachable customer segments.

C03.title: Product and execution
C03.question: What can the team deliver at the evidenced stage?
C03.evidence_required: Dated product, service or operating records against a defined capability and acceptance criterion.
C03.counter_test: Check failed tests, unavailable features, manual workarounds and delivery dependencies.
C03.decision_use: Qualify claims about product maturity and delivery risk.

C04.title: Team and governance
C04.question: Who controls delivery and decisions, and what track record is evidenced?
C04.evidence_required: Named responsibilities, relevant execution history and decision rights.
C04.counter_test: Check contradictory biographies, conflicts and departures that change who can deliver.
C04.decision_use: Assess execution, governance and key-person dependencies.

C05.title: Market and competition
C05.question: Which alternatives compete for the same buyer and budget?
C05.evidence_required: Comparable offers and buyer substitution evidence matched by segment, geography, period and unit.
C05.counter_test: Look for private or manual substitutes, old price lists and scope mismatches.
C05.decision_use: Assess market access, price position and adoption alternatives.

C06.title: Revenue and economics
C06.question: What drives recognised revenue and contribution at the current stage?
C06.evidence_required: Revenue mechanism and reconciled operating inputs where available, with actual, contracted and projected amounts identified.
C06.counter_test: Look for refundable deposits, free pilots, bookings and pass-through amounts presented as earned revenue.
C06.decision_use: Set revenue quality and defensible unit-economics assumptions.

C07.title: Cash and capital
C07.question: Which dated cash and funding constraints affect the next decision?
C07.evidence_required: Unrestricted cash, commitments, cash movement and timing or a precise request for the missing records.
C07.counter_test: Test restricted cash, delayed collections and conditional finance against the same timeline.
C07.decision_use: Determine funding needs, liquidity exposure and timing.

C08.title: Defensibility
C08.question: What evidence suggests an advantage can survive replication or switching?
C08.evidence_required: Customer behaviour, protected rights or operational economics that can be traced to the advantage.
C08.counter_test: Identify reproducible features, weak IP coverage, multi-homing and low switching costs.
C08.decision_use: Test durability and the persistence of value drivers.

C09.title: Regulatory and operational risks
C09.question: Which operational, regulatory or other dependencies could prevent delivery?
C09.evidence_required: A scoped dependency and compliance record for the entity, geography and actual operations.
C09.counter_test: Check scope limits, expired or conditional permissions, and any reliance on an uncommitted third party.
C09.decision_use: Identify conditions that could block operations or invalidate the decision.

C10.title: Thesis and valuation drivers
C10.question: What observable change would invalidate the independent case or valuation basis?
C10.evidence_required: The primary decision drivers, a practical falsifier and the method eligibility or missing valuation input.
C10.counter_test: Test whether plausible adverse data changes the recommended decision or disqualifies the method.
C10.decision_use: Qualify the thesis, valuation and final decision.

ST01.title: Concept validation
ST01.question: What credible evidence supports the problem at concept stage?
ST01.evidence_required: A dated record of customer discovery and a costed test that could falsify willingness to pay.
ST01.counter_test: Look for leading questions, samples dominated by friends and actual behaviour that conflicts with stated interest.
ST01.decision_use: Decide whether to fund or refine problem validation.

ST02.title: Development milestone feasibility
ST02.question: Which development milestone will demonstrate feasibility within the available resources?
ST02.evidence_required: Current readiness, evidence against explicit acceptance criteria and dated cost-to-milestone assumptions.
ST02.counter_test: Check failed tests, prototype conditions and unbudgeted commercial requirements.
ST02.decision_use: Test feasibility, execution timing and milestone funding.

ST03.title: Pilot conversion
ST03.question: What did the pilot actually prove and what would convert it to commercial use?
ST03.evidence_required: Pilot scope, acceptance results, paying status, and the next commitment with a representative counterpart.
ST03.counter_test: Test free or subsidised use, selection bias and conditions unlikely to hold in production.
ST03.decision_use: Qualify pilot evidence and the next commercial milestone.

ST04.title: Early revenue quality
ST04.question: Is initial revenue collectible and repeatable beyond the first customers?
ST04.evidence_required: Recognised sales, delivery, collections and representative renewal or reorder evidence.
ST04.counter_test: Reconcile discounted, related-party or one-off sales and delayed collections.
ST04.decision_use: Separate initial trading from repeatable revenue assumptions.

ST05.title: Repeatable growth
ST05.question: What drives repeatable growth as the company adds customers and costs?
ST05.evidence_required: Comparable cohorts, concentration and incremental retention, contribution and capacity measures.
ST05.counter_test: Test weakening later cohorts, channel dependency and acquisition costs after incentives.
ST05.decision_use: Stress unit economics and working capital under growth.

ST06.title: Mature operating cash
ST06.question: How much sustainable cash does a mature business generate after necessary reinvestment?
ST06.evidence_required: Multi-period normalised operations, maintenance spend and working capital with documented scope.
ST06.counter_test: Remove cyclical windfalls, underinvestment and revenue concentration effects.
ST06.decision_use: Anchor sustainable cash generation and method eligibility.

ST07.title: Stage verification
ST07.question: What evidence would establish achieved commercial maturity?
ST07.evidence_required: Dated product, customer and sales records that can resolve the most consequential stage distinction.
ST07.counter_test: Check whether projected or unpaid activity is being used to imply actual revenue or repeatable growth.
ST07.decision_use: Select a supported stage or preserve the uncertainty.

OB01.title: Investment conditions
OB01.question: Which evidence or transaction conditions could reverse the investment decision?
OB01.evidence_required: Decision conditions, downside exposure and the evidence or terms on which a commitment depends.
OB01.counter_test: Find reversals under adverse assumptions or governing terms that change the economic rights.
OB01.decision_use: Specify the investment decision and diligence conditions.

OB02.title: Fundraising readiness
OB02.question: Which evidence, use of funds and milestones are needed for fundraising readiness?
OB02.evidence_required: A dated funding plan, credible milestones, the story-to-record reconciliation and the exact asks.
OB02.counter_test: Test whether proposed funds cover the downside and whether headline traction survives reconciliation.
OB02.decision_use: Determine which evidence or operational work should precede fundraising.

OB03.title: Mandate fit
OB03.question: Does the company meet the scoped mandate and engagement criteria?
OB03.evidence_required: User or firm mandate, target criteria, any exclusion and the assessed company's supporting records.
OB03.counter_test: Check conflicts, legal entity mismatches and ambiguous eligibility boundaries.
OB03.decision_use: Decide whether to progress or qualify the mandate.

OB04.title: Valuation eligibility
OB04.question: What is the defendable value basis, method and sensitivity at the cut-off date?
OB04.evidence_required: Basis, purpose, period, eligible methods and traceable assumptions or missing inputs.
OB04.counter_test: Disqualify methods when comparables, sustainable flows, rights or financing terms are unsupported.
OB04.decision_use: Support a conditional range or withhold valuation.

OB05.title: Strategic options
OB05.question: Which strategic choice improves the binding operating or capital constraint?
OB05.evidence_required: Defined options, resource needs, opportunity costs and measurable decision triggers.
OB05.counter_test: Test a credible alternative, downside and execution bottleneck.
OB05.decision_use: Compare actions and set a decision threshold.

OB06.title: Custom decision conditions
OB06.question: Which unresolved evidence matters most to the declared decision?
OB06.evidence_required: An explicit objective, decision thresholds and the observations needed to change them.
OB06.counter_test: Find plausible findings that point to a different action.
OB06.decision_use: Keep a custom or provisional objective testable.

SA04.title: Subscription workflow validation
SA04.question: Can the proposed workflow reach paying users or a representative paid pilot?
SA04.evidence_required: Scoped adoption test, integration requirements and buyer payment or acceptance evidence.
SA04.counter_test: Check concierge delivery, promotional sign-ups and interest without commitment.
SA04.decision_use: Test commercial readiness before measuring mature SaaS economics.

SA01.title: Recurring revenue quality
SA01.question: How much contracted recurring revenue is evidenced and reconcilable?
SA01.evidence_required: Subscription ledger, period and bridge excluding one-offs, bookings and implementation income.
SA01.counter_test: Trace churn, pauses, reclassifications and annualisation of non-recurring receipts.
SA01.decision_use: Set the recurring revenue base for valuation and growth.

SA02.title: Retention and acquisition
SA02.question: What do mature cohort retention and acquisition costs show?
SA02.evidence_required: Dated cohorts, acquisition cost, denominator definitions and retention or contribution by segment.
SA02.counter_test: Test newer cohorts, excluded churn and incentives omitted from acquisition cost.

SA03.title: Scalability
SA03.question: Does the service scale after support and hosting costs?
SA03.evidence_required: Unit contribution and delivery cost across customer bands and volume.
SA03.counter_test: Find manual onboarding, committed hosting and support costs excluded from margins.
SA03.decision_use: Test incremental contribution and scaling limits.

MP01.title: Liquidity and repeat usage
MP01.question: Can each side reliably find and complete a match?
MP01.evidence_required: Comparable demand, supply, completed matches and time-to-match in an actual operating segment.
MP01.counter_test: Separate manual matches, incentive-dependent volume and repeated requests from genuine liquidity.
MP01.decision_use: Identify the binding side and location of liquidity.

MP02.title: GMV and monetisation
MP02.question: What recognised marketplace revenue survives refunds and incentives?
MP02.evidence_required: GMV reconciled to fees, refunds, discounts and recognised revenue at a matching period.
MP02.counter_test: Test principal-versus-agent presentation, pass-through value and incentives booked outside fees.
MP02.decision_use: Set defensible take rate and contribution assumptions.

MP03.title: Network resilience
MP03.question: How resilient are liquidity and margin to loss of dominant participants?
MP03.evidence_required: Concentration, retention, off-platform behaviour and market-level economics by side.
MP03.counter_test: Test multi-homing, disintermediation and removal of acquisition incentives.

MF04.title: Production readiness
MF04.question: Which trials or validations establish production readiness?
MF04.evidence_required: Dated production trial, yield and acceptance conditions, plus funded scale-up gates.
MF04.counter_test: Compare prototype conditions, rework, incomplete approvals and factory constraints.
MF04.decision_use: Determine whether projected production can be supported.

MF01.title: Capacity and yield
MF01.question: What effective capacity and first-pass yield are demonstrated?
MF01.evidence_required: Production and quality records at specified shifts, product mix and utilisation.
MF01.counter_test: Compare rated capacity with downtime, scrap, rework and changeovers.
MF01.decision_use: Test deliverable volume and direct cost assumptions.

MF02.title: Capital and working capital
MF02.question: How much capital and working capital are needed at the planned scale?
MF02.evidence_required: Dated capex, inventory, customer credit and supplier terms linked to output.
MF02.counter_test: Check maintenance spend, slow inventory, long receivable cycles and unsupported purchase credit.
MF02.decision_use: Stress cash conversion and required financing.

MF03.title: Supply and execution
MF03.question: Which suppliers, orders or quality requirements could stop production?
MF03.evidence_required: Supplier approvals, customer order quality, quality terms and capacity commitments.
MF03.counter_test: Find sole sources, cancellable orders, warranties and qualification delays.
MF03.decision_use: Test continuity, order credibility and delivery risk.

CO01.title: Repeat demand
CO01.question: Do end customers purchase repeatedly without launch promotions?
CO01.evidence_required: Comparable customer/order cohorts with returns, discount and repeat-window definitions.
CO01.counter_test: Check sell-in versus consumer sell-through and behaviour after subsidies.
CO01.decision_use: Test repeat demand and sustainable revenue.

CO02.title: Channel contribution
CO02.question: Are distribution channels profitable at realised prices?
CO02.evidence_required: Channel-level realised price and contribution after trade spend, returns and delivery costs.
CO02.counter_test: Find one-off placement revenue, hidden listing fees or negative margins masked by blended results.
CO02.decision_use: Identify profitable growth channels and costs.

CO03.title: Inventory
CO03.question: How does inventory risk change under slower demand?
CO03.evidence_required: Sell-through, ageing, expiry or return rights and associated working capital.
CO03.counter_test: Test inventory pushed into distributors and returns or obsolescence after the period cut-off.
CO03.decision_use: Forecast inventory losses and liquidity under slower sales.

LE04.title: Lending perimeter
LE04.question: Which entity originates and holds the credit exposure in the relevant jurisdiction?
LE04.evidence_required: Documented origination, servicing, licence and risk-transfer perimeter, with identified sources.
LE04.counter_test: Check activity outside the authorised scope and origination or funding agreements that leave residual risk.
LE04.decision_use: Determine legal operating perimeter and retained credit exposure.

LE01.title: Credit performance
LE01.question: How do comparable vintages perform after delinquency and write-off?
LE01.evidence_required: Loan-book cohorts, delinquency definitions, recoveries and vintage maturity.
LE01.counter_test: Check evergreening, restructured vintages, collections lags and write-offs excluded from performance.
LE01.decision_use: Stress credit losses and reported portfolio quality.

LE02.title: Funding and capital
LE02.question: Can funding and capital absorb losses and timing mismatches?
LE02.evidence_required: Dated financing, covenant and capital terms, maturities and downside funding needs.
LE02.counter_test: Test committed lines, funding concentration and triggers under delayed collections.
LE02.decision_use: Estimate financing headroom and loss absorption.

LE03.title: Risk-adjusted economics
LE03.question: What is contribution after funding, servicing, acquisition and credit losses?
LE03.evidence_required: Comparable risk-adjusted unit economics with matched portfolio periods and product boundaries.
LE03.counter_test: Include loss reserves, collections costs and new-originations mix that change reported margins.
LE03.decision_use: Determine whether lending economics hold across vintages.

BI01.title: Clinical evidence
BI01.question: Which clinical milestones are supported by the available records?
BI01.evidence_required: Published or registered results matched to indication, population, endpoint and trial phase.
BI01.counter_test: Check protocol/result changes, unresolved adverse findings and unsupported comparisons across populations.
BI01.decision_use: Bound evidence and uncertainty for the next decision.

BI02.title: Regulatory and IP
BI02.question: What regulatory status and rights are in force for the stated indication and geography?
BI02.evidence_required: Dated authority record, indication and material rights, with explicit unresolved gates.
BI02.counter_test: Check narrower authorisations, changed timelines and rights exclusions.
BI02.decision_use: Identify regulatory or rights constraints on timing.

BI03.title: Capital to milestones
BI03.question: How much cash is needed to reach the next defined development milestone?
BI03.evidence_required: Dated operating and financing plan tied to documented milestone decisions.
BI03.counter_test: Check failed gates, delayed timelines and commitments excluded from the funding requirement.
BI03.decision_use: Assess dilution and funding needs around milestone timing.

DT01.title: Technical validation
DT01.question: What technical performance is demonstrated under relevant conditions?
DT01.evidence_required: Dated test criteria, prototype scope and independent comparisons where available.
DT01.counter_test: Identify failed checks, controlled conditions and requirements that remain untested.
DT01.decision_use: Assess readiness and unresolved technical dependencies.

DT02.title: Commercialisation
DT02.question: Can the proven capability meet buyer requirements at commercial cost?
DT02.evidence_required: Buyer acceptance, deployment timeline and manufacturing or integration economics.
DT02.counter_test: Test unresolved certification, low-volume cost and an unsubsidised customer requirement.
DT02.decision_use: Test time-to-market and cost to scale.

DT03.title: IP and capital
DT03.question: Which exclusive rights, infrastructure and capital are required?
DT03.evidence_required: Documented commercial rights, dependencies and financing to the next unit-cost or readiness gate.
DT03.counter_test: Check third-party IP, uncommitted specialised infrastructure and cost overruns.
DT03.decision_use: Assess operating feasibility and capital requirements.

SV01.title: Delivery economics
SV01.question: What contribution is delivered per project or billable team?
SV01.evidence_required: Comparable project revenue, delivery cost, staffing and invoice recovery.
SV01.counter_test: Include unpaid effort, scope overruns and pass-through subcontractor costs.
SV01.decision_use: Test delivery unit economics and cash collection.

SV02.title: Repeat and concentration
SV02.question: Do repeat assignments and pipeline reduce customer concentration?
SV02.evidence_required: Renewals, repeat project counts and client concentration by period.
SV02.counter_test: Check one-off contracts, founder-relationship dependency and weak pipeline conversion.

SV03.title: Scalability
SV03.question: Can delivery capacity scale while preserving quality and margin?
SV03.evidence_required: Capacity, hiring and management span data with quality or service outcomes.
SV03.counter_test: Test utilisation peaks, subcontractor dependency and unpriced management overhead.
SV03.decision_use: Forecast scalable contribution and staffing constraints.

OT01.title: Model-specific economics
OT01.question: What is the company-specific unit of value and economic exchange?
OT01.evidence_required: Named payer, unit of measure, delivery costs and timing evidence.
OT01.counter_test: Find stated payers, prices or realised revenue that differ from observed transactions.
OT01.decision_use: Establish the operating and financial mechanism.

OT02.title: Model-specific risk
OT02.question: Which model-specific dependency could change the assessment?
OT02.evidence_required: Evidence of the dominant bottleneck, commitments and alternatives.
OT02.counter_test: Test breaks under delay, funding loss or substitution.
OT02.decision_use: Define the binding risk and diligence response.

MP04.title: Two-sided launch validation
MP04.question: Which buyers and suppliers would join the first market, and under what conditions?
MP04.evidence_required: Scoped buyer and supplier commitments and a testable definition of a successful first match.
MP04.counter_test: Compare sign-ups without commitment, manual matching and the need for incentives.
MP04.decision_use: Assess whether there is enough initial participation to test liquidity.

CO04.title: Consumer purchase validation
CO04.question: Will the intended customer buy the offer at a proposed price and channel?
CO04.evidence_required: Dated purchase tests or commitments with conditions, price and customer sample.
CO04.counter_test: Check free samples, promotional intent and channel revenue presented as consumer purchase.
CO04.decision_use: Assess launch demand and conditions for a repeat-purchase test.

SV04.title: Service launch feasibility
SV04.question: Can the team deliver an initial contracted service at the indicated rate and scope?
SV04.evidence_required: Defined deliverables, staffing and cost assumptions and evidence of client commitment.
SV04.counter_test: Check unpaid pilots, scope ambiguity and missing delivery or subcontractor costs.
SV04.decision_use: Test readiness to deliver and the evidence needed for contribution analysis.

BI04.title: Development evidence and milestones
BI04.question: Which early development milestone has been independently documented?
BI04.evidence_required: Dated milestone records, the next review threshold and any limits on translation to clinical evidence.
BI04.counter_test: Check missing validation records, changed milestone criteria and unsupported clinical claims.
BI04.decision_use: Set the evidence standard and funding conditions for the next programme milestone.
